title: 18Vitorp
script:
--// Serviços
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

--// GUI Setup
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "DeltaFakeGUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 140) -- menor
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true
frame.Parent = gui

local uicorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
uicorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
uicorner.Parent = frame

--// Título
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22) -- menor
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "@18Vitorp"
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.TextSize = 14
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
title.Parent = frame

--// Função para criar botões compactos
local function createButton(name, posY, text)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 24) -- menor largura e altura
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, posY)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 13 -- menor fonte
    btn.Text = text
    btn.Parent = frame

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    corner.Parent = btn

    return btn
end

--// Botão Night Vision
local nightVisionOn = false
local nightBtn = createButton("NightBtn", 35, "NIGHT VISION [OFF]")

nightBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    nightVisionOn = not nightVisionOn
    nightBtn.Text = nightVisionOn and "NIGHT VISION [ON]" or "NIGHT VISION [OFF]"

    if not nightVisionOn then
        -- Restaura configurações padrões
        Lighting.Brightness = 2
        Lighting.ClockTime = 14
        Lighting.FogEnd = 1000
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
        Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0
    end
end)

-- Mantém a visão noturna clara
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if nightVisionOn then
        Lighting.Brightness = 10 -- brilho muito forte
        Lighting.ClockTime = 14 -- sempre de dia
        Lighting.FogEnd = 1000000 -- remove neblina
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) -- ilumina geral
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) -- remove sombras
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false -- sem sombras escuras
        Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 2 -- aumenta a claridade
    end
end)

--// Botão Speed 50
local speedOn = false
local speedBtn = createButton("SpeedBtn", 65, "SPEED 50 [OFF]")

speedBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    speedOn = not speedOn
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = speedOn and 50 or 16
        speedBtn.Text = speedOn and "SPEED 50 [ON]" or "SPEED 50 [OFF]"
    end
end)

--// Botão Aura Player (ESP)
local espOn = false
local espBtn = createButton("ESPBtn", 95, "AURA PLAYER [OFF]")

local highlights = {}

local function addESP(plr)
    if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
        local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        highlight.Parent = plr.Character
        highlights[plr] = highlight
    end
end

local function toggleESP(state)
    if state then
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            addESP(plr)
            plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
                task.wait(1)
                addESP(plr)
            end)
        end
    else
        for _, h in pairs(highlights) do
            h:Destroy()
        end
        highlights = {}
    end
end

espBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    espOn = not espOn
    toggleESP(espOn)
    espBtn.Text = espOn and "AURA PLAYER [ON]" or "AURA PLAYER [OFF]"
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
    if espOn then
        plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            task.wait(1)
            addESP(plr)
        end)
    end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
    if highlights[plr] then
        highlights[plr]:Destroy()
        highlights[plr] = nil
    end
end)
